# No Spoon Necessary

> > Restaurant-quality recipes designed for home cooks who want impressive meals without complicated techniques.

No Spoon Necessary is a recipe collection site created by chef Cheyanne Holzworth, featuring hundreds of easy, restaurant-quality recipes organized by type and cuisine. The site emphasizes weeknight dinners, comfort food, and chef-developed cooking techniques accessible to home cooks.

## Key Topics

- Easy Recipes
- Weeknight Dinners
- Restaurant-Quality
- Pasta Recipes
- Sheet Pan Dinners
- Comfort Food
- Chef-Developed
- Quick Recipes
- Creamy Sauces
- Home Cooking
- Dips & Condiments
- Cheyanne Holzworth
- Le Cordon Bleu
- Mediterranean Cuisine
- One-Pot Meals

## Core Navigation

- [No Spoon Necessary - Easy Restaurant Quality Recipes](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com): Homepage showcasing hundreds of restaurant-quality recipes from chef Cheyanne
- [Recipe Index - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/recipes): Browsable recipe index with categories, cuisines, and ingredient search
- [About - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/about): About Cheyanne Holzworth-Bany, culinary professional and recipe creator

## Recipe Categories

- [Snacks Archives - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/recipe-type/snacks): Collection of homemade snack recipes from falafels to granola
- [Dips & Salsas Archives - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/recipe-type/dips-salsas): Extensive dips and salsas collection including hummus and Mexican salsas
- [Casseroles Archives - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/recipe-type/casseroles): Hearty casserole recipes for comfort food weeknight dinners
- [Condiments Archives - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/recipe-type/condiments): Homemade condiment recipes including sauces, pesto, and spreads

## Pasta & One-Pot Dinners

- [Creamy Chicken Lemon Pasta With Basil & Peas: One Pot Recipe - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/one-pot-creamy-lemon-chicken-pasta-basil-peas): 30-minute creamy lemon chicken pasta with basil and peas
- [Arugula Pasta Recipe: A Peppery Twist on Pesto Pasta - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/arugula-pesto-pasta-with-blistered-tomatoes-burrata): 30-minute arugula pesto pasta with tomatoes and burrata cheese
- [Creamy Italian Sausage Pasta: Easy 35-Minute Dinner Recipe - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/creamy-sausage-pasta-recipe): 35-minute creamy Italian sausage pasta with peppers and cream sauce
- [Pork and Noodle Stir Fry: 30-Minute Pork Udon Noodles - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/udon-noodle-stir-fry): 30-minute pork udon stir fry with garlic and umami-packed sauce

## Sheet Pan & Protein Dinners

- [Sheet Pan Shrimp Dinner: Quick, Tasty Shrimp and Potato Recipe - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/sheet-pan-garlic-lemon-shrimp-asparagus-fingerling-potatoes): 6-ingredient sheet pan shrimp with lemon-garlic and crispy potatoes
- [Baked Honey Mustard Chicken: A Quick, Ridiculously Easy Recipe - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/honey-mustard-chicken): Easy one-pan baked honey mustard chicken with glossy sauce
- [Slow Cooker Peanut Thai Chicken: Bold Flavor, Zero Effort - No Spoon Necessary](https://www.nospoonnecessary.com/slow-cooker-thai-peanut-chicken): Slow cooker Thai peanut chicken with coconut milk and lime
